// diagnostic

E-ERR-SUFFIX

`Error!` is a retired suffix failure contract.

What

`Error!` is a retired suffix failure contract.

Why

Jet puts the error contract before its type so the success role and error role stay distinct in every type position.

Fix

Write `!Error`, or write `?Success !Error` when the success can be absent.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E-ERR-SUFFIX: tests/ui/cffi_callback_nullable.stderr.
